name: Spear of Destiny: The Kaiseki
storyline:
In a world shrouded in darkness, powerful enemies have seized control. Centuries ago, the Light’s Lords vanquished these foes with the legendary Spear of Destiny.

Now, monsters and orcs run rampant, unchecked. Only one last hero of the Light’s Lords clings to the ancient legend. He journeys across treacherous lands, seeking the fabled Spear of Destiny.

Join the fight for freedom against these formidable adversaries, just as your ancestors did long ago.

The epic battle begins now.
